headline: Nvidia in Talks to Guarantee $250 Billion Financing for OpenAI Ohio Data Center
raw_snippet: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee roughly $250 billion of financing so OpenAI can lease a 10-gigawatt data center that SoftBank's SB Energy is building on a former uranium-enrichment site in southern Ohio. headline: OpenAI IPO Likely Delayed to 2027 as Altman Insists on $1 Trillion Valuation

headline: OpenAI Slashes GPT-5.6 Luna Prices by 80%, Terra by 20%, Adds Sol Fast Mode
raw_snippet: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% to $0.20/$1.20 per million input/output tokens, and Terra by 20% to $2/$12, just three weeks after the GPT-5.6 family's public launch. headline: EU AI Act Enforcement Powers Activate; OpenAI's Compliance Statement Omits Copyright Chapter
raw_snippet: The European Commission gained new enforcement powers on August 2 under the EU AI Act, including the ability to demand evaluation of AI models before EU release, restrict market access, and fine providers up to 15 million euros or 3% of annual turnover. OpenAI signed the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice but its compliance statement notably omitted the copyright transparency chapter, which requires a publicly available training data summary.

headline: Sam Altman Calls for Pacing AI Development; 1,178 AI Lab Employees Sign 'Pacing the Frontier' Letter

headline: EU Set to Designate ChatGPT as 'Very Large Search Engine' Under Digital Services Act

headline: OpenAI's Astra Model Solves Ten Open Problems in Mathematics, Publishes Lean Proofs
raw_snippet: OpenAI announced that an internal version of Astra, its next major model family, solved ten previously open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, publishing formal Lean 4 proofs on GitHub. The headline result is the first-ever explicit construction of a non-sofic group, resolving a central question in group theory open since 1999. The proofs were achieved for roughly $2,000 in compute, and Fields Medal winner Timothy Gowers said he would recommend one of the proofs for a top journal.
